title: 1417. Reformat The String

examples.explanation: No two adjacent characters have the same type in "0a1b2c". "a0b1c2", "0a1b2c", "0c2a1b" are also valid permutations.
"leetcode" has only characters so we cannot separate them by digits.
"1229857369" has only digits so we cannot separate them by characters.
